done_when: The sign-off stop is shown only for findings still open on the latest commit, and a version-only upgrade keeps the last green full test run.
why: A saved sign-off stop is shown without checking commits pushed after that round, so the owner can be asked about a finding that a repair already closed. A forge.toml version change after an upgrade also counts as a product change, so the client must run the full tests again before sign-off.
